mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction starts below 700k units signals weakening housing demand, which reduces confidence in the broader economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) indicates a demand shock where consumers are spending less despite higher prices, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 58% of interaction-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in non-farm payrolls and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market recovery, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 98.0 index level, combined with stable or declining unemployment, indicates strong manufacturing output and labor utilization, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 58% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%), signals a weak economy under inflationary pressure, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
